findings.element: Update Shopify qty confirmation dialog (bulk and row), Stock check tab
findings.finding: The dialog only lists signed numbers ("+8", "+2") that Synder "will send" and never says what the Shopify quantity will be afterwards or whether this can be undone, so a non-expert can't tell if Shopify goes to 140 or gets 8 added on top of an already-updated count.
findings.user_impact: Already afraid of irreversible mistakes, the owner either cancels and leaves the difference open, or clicks confirm without knowing what they did to live store stock.
findings.suggested_fix: State the result per product in plain words, e.g. "Ceramic plate 24cm: Shopify 132 → 140 (same as QuickBooks)", and add one line on what happens if it turns out wrong (e.g. the next comparison will show it again).

evidence.quote:
Synder will send these differences, as found in the latest comparison of My ceramic plates on Oct 2, 2026 02:30:
Ceramic plate 24cm: +8
Mug set: +2

findings.element: Overview Stock check block (State 3) and Stock check tab empty table
findings.finding: Right after saying My good flowers wasn't compared, the block shows a green check "Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify." (and the tab shows "No unresolved differences."), which reads as all stores being fine when one was never checked.
findings.user_impact: The owner reads the green check as "everything matches", skips "Compare now", and believes the job is done while a store's stock may be off.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the store the all-clear applies to, e.g. "My ceramic plates: stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify.", and in the tab say "No differences in My ceramic plates. My good flowers wasn't compared."

findings.finding: The first step asks the owner to change a Synder setting with an unexplained name ("Created product should be") to an unexplained value ("Inventory") and gives no hint of what else that setting affects.
findings.user_impact: A first-timer worries that changing a setting in Settings will alter how their sales are recorded and hesitates or stops at step 1.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a one-line plain explanation and reassurance, e.g. "Inventory means Synder creates products that track stock count in QuickBooks; this only affects new products and you can change it back in Settings."

evidence.quote: In Settings › Products/Services, set Created product should be to Inventory and click Update. This page updates by itself.

gaps: Ignore (row and bulk): no commit path recorded, so whether it asks for confirmation, explains that the difference stays in Shopify, or can be reversed is unknown
Compare now: behaviour after clicking (on the Overview and the Stock check tab) is not recorded, so I can't judge whether the failed-store message clears or explains the failure
Onboarding step rows 1/2: cursor/hover affordance not recorded, so KF-4 (numbered rows looking clickable when they are not) can't be checked

Enable after onboarding: the Sync block and its Enable dialog are out of scope (variant 1), so whether the 'ready, click Enable' hand-off reassures that enabling won't overwrite Shopify totals is not assessed here; the toast text is transient and was only seen in control notes
